IF02 – Customer Information
The TMF691 Federated Identity API provides federated user identity, authorization and managed business-asset information to authorized applications. It provides UserInfo from Vodafone ID (IDaaS), including identity attributes such as email and phone, user roles and permissions, and Customer Account, Billing Account and Product/Subscription assets. OAuth 2.0 access tokens protect the API.

Key operations:
• GET /userInfo – information about the currently authenticated user.
• GET /userInfo/{sub} – information about a specific identity.
• GET /userInfo/{sub}/userAssets – roles and managed business assets.
• POST /userInfo – create an identity.
• PATCH /userInfo/{sub} – update an identity.
• DELETE /userInfo/{sub} – delete an identity.
• PATCH /userInfo/{sub}/userAssets – manage roles and assets.

User assets use these principal mappings: owner → Customer Account; admin → Billing Account; user → Product/Subscription. Supported combinations include customer/owner, account/billingAccount/admin and product/mobile-or-fixed/user.

TMF691 operates between Vodafone ID and the business APIs TMF629 Customer Management, TMF666 Account Management and TMF637 Product Inventory. Roles and permissions are stored in MongoDB. AuthX uses TMF691 during OAuth Token Exchange to retrieve identity, roles and assets and enrich the local DXL access token with authorization information.

Source: https://confluence-agile.oskarmobil.cz/display/OCP/FS+-+TMF691+Federated+Identity+API+-+federated-identity-fs

IF13 – User Role Eligibility (TMF691)
The interface provides a consolidated eligibility result indicating whether a VFID user has an approved administrator role in WSC (V4) or ONSC (V2). The input is the user's OAuth 2.0 token; the output is Eligibility = TRUE/FALSE, so the consumer does not need to query both source systems separately.

The federated authorization API runs on the Local DXL layer and uses OAuth 2.0 Token Exchange. TMF691 provides the consolidated user identity, roles and permissions. Role and permission data are obtained through TMF672 and local or group asset inventories.

Role sources include:
• WSC/V4: Owner, Admin and User.
• ONSC/V2: End User Admin (EUA) and Association Level Admin (ALA).

The interface maps these source roles into a unified authorization model and evaluates administrator eligibility across both channels.

The Marketplace/AppDirect interface provides ServiceHub with information about customer companies, products and subscriptions in Vodafone Marketplace, including subscription status and the relationships between companies, products and subscriptions. It also supports user and membership data, user roles and reseller relationships.

The integration uses REST and GraphQL APIs protected by OAuth 2.0; webhooks synchronize changes. AppDirect is the marketplace backend platform. Typical operations include:
• GET /company/{companyId} – company information.
• GET /company/{companyId}/users – company users and memberships.
• GET /orders/{orderId} – order detail.
• GET /orders?status=DRAFT – orders filtered by status.
• POST /orders – create an order.

OIDC/OAuth2 Authorization Code Flow; shared code; DXL token exchange

The interface provides SSO and authenticated identity transfer between applications over Vodafone ID (IDaaS).

OIDC Authorization Code Flow:
• Authorization request: response_type=code; scope=openid phone email profile offline_access OPENID_TOKEN_SHARING_PRODUCER local_sub; acr_values=urn:vodafone:loa:gold.
• VFID returns an authorization code, which is exchanged for access_token, id_token and refresh_token; token_type=Bearer.

Shared Code identity transfer:
• The source application uses scope OPENID_TOKEN_SHARING_PRODUCER; the target application uses OPENID_TOKEN_SHARING_CONSUMER.
• Source call: POST /oauth2/share-code?grant_id=<grant_id>, Authorization: Bearer <idaas_access_token>.
• Response fields: expires_in, issued_at, shared_code and token_type=sharedCode.
• Target login: GET /oidc/authorize with login_hint=SC:<shared_code>.
• The user is not prompted to authenticate again; processing continues through the standard Authorization Code Flow.

DXL token exchange:
• Call: POST /OAuth2TokenExchangeGrant/v2/token.
• Parameters: grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange; subject_token_type=urn:vodafone:params:oauth:token-type:vodafone_id; subject_token=<idaas_access_token>; subject_token_iss=<idaas_host>.
• Purpose: validate the IDaaS token, load identity and user assets, and create a DXL JWT token.
• AuthX calls IDaaS /oidc/introspect and /oidc/userinfo, retrieves roles and assets through TMF691 Federated Identity, and returns a DXL access token with user permissions.

Simplified flow: User → VFID/IDaaS → Authorization Code → Application A → /oauth2/share-code → shared_code → Application B → OIDC authorize (login_hint=SC:<shared_code>) → Authorization Code → IDaaS Access Token → /OAuth2TokenExchangeGrant/v2/token → DXL Token.

Sources: https://confluence-agile.oskarmobil.cz/display/OCP/WSC+FE+-+Auth ; https://confluence-agile.oskarmobil.cz/display/OCP/VFID+01.09+-+SSO ; https://confluence-agile.oskarmobil.cz/display/OCP/VFID+01.01+-+DXL+Token+Exchange

Rozhraní zajišťuje SSO a přenos autentizované identity mezi aplikacemi nad Vodafone ID (IDaaS).

OIDC Authorization Code Flow:
• Autorizační požadavek: response_type=code; scope=openid phone email profile offline_access OPENID_TOKEN_SHARING_PRODUCER local_sub; acr_values=urn:vodafone:loa:gold.
• VFID vrátí autorizační kód, který se vymění za access_token, id_token a refresh_token; token_type=Bearer.

Shared Code – přenos identity:
• Zdrojová aplikace používá scope OPENID_TOKEN_SHARING_PRODUCER; cílová aplikace používá OPENID_TOKEN_SHARING_CONSUMER.
• Volání zdrojové aplikace: POST /oauth2/share-code?grant_id=<grant_id>, Authorization: Bearer <idaas_access_token>.
• Odpověď obsahuje expires_in, issued_at, shared_code a token_type=sharedCode.
• Přihlášení cílové aplikace: GET /oidc/authorize s login_hint=SC:<shared_code>.
• Uživatel není znovu vyzván k přihlášení; tok pokračuje standardním Authorization Code Flow.

DXL Token Exchange:
• Volání: POST /OAuth2TokenExchangeGrant/v2/token.
• Parametry: grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange; subject_token_type=urn:vodafone:params:oauth:token-type:vodafone_id; subject_token=<idaas_access_token>; subject_token_iss=<idaas_host>.
• Účel: validace IDaaS tokenu, načtení identity a user assets a vytvoření DXL JWT tokenu.
• AuthX volá IDaaS /oidc/introspect a /oidc/userinfo, získává role a assety přes TMF691 Federated Identity a vrací DXL access token s uživatelskými oprávněními.

Zjednodušený tok: User → VFID/IDaaS → Authorization Code → Application A → /oauth2/share-code → shared_code → Application B → OIDC authorize (login_hint=SC:<shared_code>) → Authorization Code → IDaaS Access Token → /OAuth2TokenExchangeGrant/v2/token → DXL Token.
